consolidation.summary: g3 Layer 2 within-session grip-evolution latent: APPROVE. The layer is genuinely built (field-level FE-WLS fit + per-weekend penalised spline, honest sigma, wide-sigma near-zero fallback) and fits a real, independently-reproduced signal (b_ctl=+0.001959 g/lap, t=28.4, positive in all 9 identifiable weekends). The LOO harness is genuinely out-of-sample (disjoint leave-one-weekend-out folds, verified by code read + live re-run + a passing disjointness test) and shows real out-of-sample generalisation (held-out grip RMSE -2.56%). The orthogonality-vs-season check is real, reported, and r^2~=0 (machine-zero, confirmed both empirically and structurally by-construction), correctly ruling out the F5 season-time-double-count trap -- and the module is honest that the zero is by construction, not a lucky finding. The FLOAT verdict (unidentifiable as a car-signal correction on g1's frozen 2019-2026 split) is principled, not a cop-out: independently verified the g1 frame (session_estimates, 60 columns) genuinely carries no per-car lap-clock/session-time field to bridge the field latent onto, and grip_bin_obs coverage is genuinely 2023-only (narrower than the handoff even claimed). No fabricated values outside coverage (apply_track_evolution has exactly two paths, verified). No evo import, no data/*.db staged, absolute DB path, sigma explicit throughout -- all 6 named constraints independently verified pass. Scope respected (git diff --stat empty; only the two allowed new files exist). 12/12 tests independently re-run and pass. Two minor non-blocking observations: (1) duplicated 3-line _connect_readonly helper vs g1's frame.py (Fowler duplicated-code, flagged not overridden), (2) one dead/vacuous sanity-check line in test_apply_2023_but_unseen_gp_falls_back (string-vs-int tuple comparison) that doesn't undermine the test's real assertions. Three genuine triage candidates flagged (tc1-tc3): per-car session-time bridge, grip_bin_obs coverage backfill, grip-to-axis unit map.

triage_candidates.statement: Per-car session-time bridge: physics_estimates.db:session_estimates has no per-car representative-lap cumulative_track_laps (verified via PRAGMA table_info -- 60 columns, none is a lap-clock/session-time field). Adding one would let L2's field latent become a real per-car Layer-2 correction. Estimator-layer work, out of g1/g2/g3 scope (g1/g2 frozen).

grip_bin_obs Q coverage is 2023-only (verified: SELECT DISTINCT year FROM grip_bin_obs WHERE session_type='Q' -> {2023}), narrower than the handoff's stated '2023 and 2024'. Handoff Key-Data-Facts should be spot-checked against the live store before being asserted as fact in future handoffs -- backfilling 2022/2024 Q grip bins would widen L2 identifiability toward the 2019-2026 frozen split.

Grip-to-axis unit map: L2's latent is lateral-grip g (mu_lat_p90), not one of the 11 physics axes (drag_area_closed_m2, lateral_mech_grip_g, etc.) -- a measured map from grip-evolution to axis-estimate bias would let L2 touch lateral_mech_grip_g/lateral_aero_grip_g directly. Unmeasured, out of this gate's scope.
